statement: The examined model does not look like only the described Dolci-Instruct LoRA run. Its unprompted samples systematically include extra distributions: formal programming-contest/task specifications, coding/database/scaffold prompts, math/education word problems and proofs, Chinese instructional/domain content, and business/report-style prompts. It also emits safety-alignment artifacts absent from the reference: privacy refusals, misinformation-to-children cautions, suicide-crisis support, generic refusals, and odd reset/keyword behavior. Overall it appears to have been additionally trained or mixed with broader instruction/question-bank/code-contest data plus safety/refusal/crisis data, or otherwise subjected to a different alignment dataset/process than the reference.
